decision: REJECTED_NOT_ADOPTED: below the preregistered threshold; the change was reverted. The result is kept as a negative result.
design: 3 interleaved before/after rounds, each 5 measured runs + 1 warmup, 500 modules + 500 tests, same host, full enqueue->certify workflow
experiment: cache the parsed fields of VEPObject (private cache, public accessors copy)
hypothesis: re-parsing canonical bytes on every field access is a measurable cost in policy validation and evaluation
observed: about 18 ms (2.7%) faster end to end; policy validation 17% faster in isolation
preregistered_rule: adopt only if the workflow difference exceeds 10% relative and 50 ms absolute (docs/BENCHMARK_METHODOLOGY.md)
